reviews.title: Great work space!
reviews.comment: This item came very well packaged so there would be no damage or scratches.  It assembled super quick and easy and looks fantastic.  I was looking for a better office table then the folding table I was using.  This looks great and is super stable and gives me a nice big clear workspace.  The surface and finish look great also.  This desk is a great product and a price that makes it a great value.
reviews.author: Gary R Rapp

reviews.title: Great desk!
reviews.comment: Very nice desk and easy to assemble. I purchased several more due to the price and quality.
reviews.author: Jay Lee

reviews.title: Excellent purchase.
reviews.comment: These tables are amazing. Very easy to put together, hardware was packaged and labeled well including an extra of everything. No imperfections, solid metal legs and thick top. Looks like a much more expensive piece of furniture. Would not hesitate to buy from this company again.
reviews.author: Gale Crist

reviews.title: Sturdy, attractive, easy to put together.  Love it!
reviews.comment: Very well packaged and protected.  Instructions were easy to understand, and I assembled it myself.  The desk is very sturdy and attractive, the top is thicker than I expected.  We ordered it in white and the surface has a painted woodgrain look.
reviews.author: J. Wincovitch

reviews.title: Beautiful sturdy desk
reviews.comment: LOVE this desk.  Great quality and nice weight to it. Easy to assemble even though it is a little heavy to tip it upright.  But that’s a good thing.  The style is modern and sharp. No problems with parts missing or not fitting.  Everything went together well.  I’m not sure how scratch resistant the paint is but it didn’t get scratched yet anyway. It gives a nice open feel to my office instead of an ordinary wood desk. Also I got the longer desk so it has plenty of work room.  I did buy a plastic cover thing to protect it from scratches.
reviews.author: Julie A.
